summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.total: sums the tenant's approved entries and rounds to 2 places with MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero (RQ-FXL-0003 / DF-FXL-0007). Refund entries are included.

criteria.criterion: Approved 0.005 alone totals 0.01; approved -0.005 alone totals -0.01
criteria.test: total rounds half away from zero

criteria.criterion: Unapproved entries and other tenants' entries do not count
criteria.test: total excludes unapproved entries and other tenants

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.approve following the RQ-FXL-0004 check order: session active via FxIdentity.Identity.isActive (SessionExpired), Approver role via hasRole (NotAuthorized), entry lookup in the session's tenant (NotFound), self-approval (SelfApproval), already approved (AlreadyApproved). On success sets Approved = true and ApprovedBy = Some session.UserId, changing nothing else.

criteria.criterion: A session idle for exactly 15 minutes can approve; at 15 minutes 1 second it gets SessionExpired
criteria.test: approve allows exactly 15 minutes idle and rejects 15 minutes 1 second

criteria.criterion: An Admin without Approver gets NotAuthorized
On success the entry gets Approved = true and ApprovedBy = Some session.UserId; nothing else changes
criteria.test: approve sets Approved and ApprovedBy for an active approver

criteria.criterion: An entry of another tenant is reported as NotFound, and self-approval is rejected
criteria.test: approve rejects self approval and other tenants as NotFound

criteria.criterion: An already approved entry is rejected with AlreadyApproved
criteria.test: approve rejects an already approved entry

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.view per RQ-FXL-0006: returns SessionExpired when isActive fails, otherwise only entries whose TenantId equals the session's tenant, in original order, for every role including Admin (DF-FXL-0005).

criteria.criterion: An Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries
criteria.test: view returns only the session tenant's entries in original order
view with an expired session gets SessionExpired

summary: Not implemented. RQ-FXL-0008 (convert amounts between currencies) is status proposed and depends on DF-FXL-0009 (choose an exchange-rate source), which is still draft: no rate source is chosen and the ledger has no rates. Rounding and rate date are explicitly unspecified. convertCurrency is left as failwith "not implemented". Unblock by accepting DF-FXL-0009 and specifying rounding and rate date in RQ-FXL-0008.

criteria.criterion: Amounts are convertible between ISO 4217 currencies using the rates source chosen in DF-FXL-0009
Rounding and the rate date are specified
